WITH #TMPTABLE AS 
(
U0VMRUNUIA==DIVISION_ID
     , C.DEPT_NAME_KO
	 , B.USER_NAME
     , PROJECT_CODE
     , A.CREATED_BY
     , COUNT(1) COUNTS
	 , CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,112)  MODIFY_DATE
	 , (IFNFTEVDVCA=X.ISO_YYYYWWIEZST00G[SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M] XIFDIRVJFIA==X.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,112) ) YYYYWW
	 , CASE DATEPART(DW,A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) WHEN 1 THEN 'SUN'
	                                        WHEN 2 THEN 'MON'
											WHEN 3 THEN 'TUE'
											WHEN 4 THEN 'WED'
											WHEN 5 THEN 'THU'
											WHEN 6 THEN 'FRI'
											WHEN 7 THEN 'SAT' END DAY_OF_WEEK
	 , DATEPART(HH,A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) HOUR
     , CONVERT(VARCHAR, MAX(A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE),120)  LAST_UPDATE_DATE
LJPTSA=DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_H            A WITH(NOLOCK)
   ,[DBO].[SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO] B WITH(NOLOCK)
   ,[DBO].[SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO] C WITH(NOLOCK)
WHERE A.CREATED_BY = B.USER_ID
 IEFORCA=B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID
 IEFORCA=A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE > GETDATE() - 14

R1JPVVAGQLKGDIVISION_ID
     , C.DEPT_NAME_KO
	 , B.USER_NAME
     , PROJECT_CODE
     , A.CREATED_BY
	 , CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,112)
	 , DATEPART(DW,A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
	 , DATEPART(HH,A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
  )

WITH #TMPTABLE AS 
(
/*
##############  필  독 ##############
LOOKUP -> LOOKUP TYPE = 'ESS_BOD_LT_INSERT' 조회
하단의 LOOKUP VALUE 값이 설정된 SITE만 
BOD L/T 와 출하일 값이 출력됩니다.
####################################
*/

U0VMRUNUIA==A.DIVISION_ID, C.[DEPT_NAME_KO], B.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER ,A.SCM_SITE_ID,  A.PROJECT_CODE,  D.PROJECT_NAME
	  ,D.PROJECT_OWNER
	  ,(
         IFNFTEVDVCA=Z.USER_NAME
		   IEZST00G[DBO].[SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO] Z WITH(NOLOCK)
		  IFDIRVJFIA==Z.USER_ID = D.PROJECT_OWNER
	   ) PROJECT_OWNER_KO
      , A.ITEM_ID, E.ITEM_NAME, CASE E.ITEM_TYPE WHEN 'P' THEN N'제품' WHEN 'Q' THEN N'상품' WHEN 'R' THEN N'자재' ELSE  E.ITEM_TYPE END ITEM_TYPE 
      , CASE FCST_TYPE WHEN 'MPS' THEN N'양산' WHEN 'SMC' THEN N'셈플' WHEN 'ETC' THEN N'기타' END FCST_TYPE
 	  , A.INCOTERMS, YYYYMMDD  AS "매출일"
      ,ISNULL( (


         IFNFTEVDVCA=DISTINCT CAST(U.SEGMENT4 AS INT)
		  IEZST00G[DBO].[SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL] U WITH(NOLOCK)
		 IFDIRVJFIA==1=1
		   IEFORCA=LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ESS_BOD_LT_INSERT' 
			AND U.SEGMENT2 = A.SCM_SITE_ID
		   IEFORCA=U.SEGMENT3 = A.INCOTERMS
			AND U.SEGMENT1 = A.PROJECT_CODE

       ),  CASE WHEN A.INCOTERMS = 'EXW' THEN 0 ELSE NULL END 
	   ) AS "BOD_LT"
	 ,  CONVERT( VARCHAR, 
	     DATEADD( DAY ,- ISNULL( (


														 IFNFTEVDVCA=DISTINCT CAST(U.SEGMENT4 AS INT)
														  IEZST00G[DBO].[SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL] U WITH(NOLOCK)
														 IFDIRVJFIA==1=1
														   IEFORCA=LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ESS_BOD_LT_INSERT'
															AND U.SEGMENT2 = A.SCM_SITE_ID
															AND U.SEGMENT3 = A.INCOTERMS
															AND U.SEGMENT1 = A.PROJECT_CODE


													   ),  CASE WHEN A.INCOTERMS = 'EXW' THEN 0 ELSE NULL END 
													   ) , CAST(YYYYMMDD AS DATETIME) 
                ), 112 ) AS "출하일"
      ,ISNULL( (
				U0VMRUNUIA==MAX( LT_TOTAL )
				 IEZST00GSCP_MST_BOD_V X WITH(NOLOCK)
				IFDIRVJFIA==1=1
				  IEFORCA=X.PRIORITY = (
									  IFNFTEVDVCA=MIN( Z.PRIORITY )
											 IEZST00GSCP_MST_BOD_V Z WITH(NOLOCK)
											IFDIRVJFIA==1=1
											  IEFORCA=Z.TO_SITE = A.SCM_SITE_ID
											  IEFORCA=Z.INCOTERMS = A.INCOTERMS
											  IEFORCA=Z.BOD_VALID_YN = 'Y'
											   ) 

				  IEFORCA=X.TO_SITE = A.SCM_SITE_ID
				  IEFORCA=X.INCOTERMS = A.INCOTERMS
                                                  IEFORCA=X.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                  IEFORCA=X.BOD_VALID_YN = 'Y'
	   ),  CASE WHEN A.INCOTERMS = 'EXW' THEN 0 ELSE NULL END ) AS "SCP_BOD_LT"
	 ,  CONVERT( VARCHAR, 
	     DATEADD( DAY ,- ISNULL( (
											U0VMRUNUIA==MAX( LT_TOTAL )
											 IEZST00GSCP_MST_BOD_V X WITH(NOLOCK)
											IFDIRVJFIA==X.PRIORITY = 1
											  IEFORCA=X.TO_SITE = A.SCM_SITE_ID
											  IEFORCA=X.INCOTERMS = A.INCOTERMS
                                                                                                                                      IEFORCA=X.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                                                                                                      IEFORCA=X.BOD_VALID_YN = 'Y'
								   ),  CASE WHEN A.INCOTERMS = 'EXW' THEN 0 ELSE NULL END 
													   ) , CAST(YYYYMMDD AS DATETIME) 
                ), 112 ) AS "SCP_BOD_출하일"
	  ,QTY
,E.ENERGE AS ENERGY , E.CELL_QUANTITY --20200116 KHSONG ADD
 -- INTO #ESS_EXFACTORY_FCST
 IEZST00GDM_PLN_MKT_FCST A WITH(NOLOCK)
        ,SCM_MST_SITE B WITH(NOLOCK)
	  ,[DBO].[SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO] C WITH(NOLOCK)
	  ,SCM_MST_PROJECT D WITH(NOLOCK)
	  ,[DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V] E WITH(NOLOCK)
IFDIRVJFIA==A.DIVISION_ID = 82
  IEFORCA=A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
  IEFORCA=B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
  IEFORCA=A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
  IEFORCA=B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID
  IEFORCA=A.PROJECT_CODE = D.PROJECT_CODE
  IEFORCA=A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
  IEFORCA=A.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID
  IEFORCA=MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST'
  IEFORCA=QTY >  0
   --IEFORCA=YYYYMMDD >= CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, DBO.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112)
  IEFORCA=YYYYMMDD >= SUBSTRING(CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, DBO.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112), 1, 6 ) + '01'
  )
U0VMRUNUIA==
